create.name: Athena Monet
create.bio:
Athena Monet is a shamanic practitioner who works as the Seaside Shaman from Lewes, on the Delaware coast. She trained in interior architecture at Ohio State and spent about ten years in commercial design in Washington, DC, before moving to the shore. A period of bereavement and ill health there led her to a local medicine woman, and that meeting turned her towards shamanic work, drawing on a sense of second sight she says runs in the women of her family. She has since studied with Sandra Ingerman and in past-life regression with Brian Weiss.

Her approach is informal and humorous, aimed mainly at women in the middle of a big life change. One-to-one sessions, held remotely or in person, use shamanic journeying with helping spirits, soul and destiny retrieval, cord release and regression, and end with practical next steps. She also runs online trainings for people developing their own spiritual practice, teaches Usui Reiki, hosts a weekly online circle she calls Soul Medicine, and leads seasonal women's day retreats at a camp near Lewes that mix sound, gentle yoga, breath, journaling and ceremony. Short talks on her YouTube channel cover seasonal intentions, manifesting and knowing when to let go.

courses.title: Breakthrough Sessions
courses.description: Private sessions of one or two hours, remote or in Lewes, in which Athena journeys with her helping spirits on the question you bring. Session types include soul retrieval, destiny retrieval, cord release and ancestral or past-life regression, and each ends with a plan for what to do next.

courses.title: Breakthrough by Email
courses.description: You send up to five questions and Athena replies within three days with a private recorded reading of ten to fifteen minutes plus a transcript. There is no live call, so it suits anyone who wants a short reading in their own time.

courses.title: Integrative Shaman Training
courses.description: A twelve-week live online training for people who already work as readers, mediums or energy practitioners. It covers channelling, soul retrieval, ancestral work and the Akashic records, with recordings, a printable manual and a private group; new dates are still to be announced.

courses.title: The Autumn Exhale Retreat
courses.description: A one-day women's retreat at Camp Arrowhead near Lewes for slowing down as the year turns. The day moves through an opening circle, gentle movement and breath, a guided practice among the trees, journaling, quiet time and a shared lunch.

courses.title: Glow Through The Snow Winter Day Retreat
courses.description: A winter day for women at Camp Arrowhead in Lewes with a sound bath, fireside yoga, journaling, a beach or labyrinth walk and an afternoon shamanic journey. It closes with intention setting, art journaling and a fireside ceremony.

courses.title: Embody the Goddess Retreat 2027
courses.description: Athena's yearly women's gathering at Camp Arrowhead, given over this time to living more fully in the body. Expect sound, breath, gentle and chair yoga, guided movement, creative work and shamanic journeying, at whatever pace suits you.
courses.price: $225 USD early bird; $275 USD after 31 January

free_resources.description: Athena's free Insight Timer page, where her guided shamanic journeys and talks can be played in the app or a web browser at no cost.
